title: Contributor identity for MCP writes
description: Actors are free-text names; anyone with the function URL can write. Decide and build how contributors are identified (e.g. Supabase Auth with OAuth for MCP clients, per-person API tokens) before the tree is shared publicly. Auth permission model: needs an owner decision. Context: DOC_POINT_AT_RISKS.md § Process and governance.

title: Rate limiting on the point-at Edge Function
description: Add Postgres-backed rate limiting to the point-at function per .claude/rules/project-specific.md once contributor identity exists (limits need a stable key per actor).

title: Fill node embeddings and add semantic search
description: The embedding column (384 dims, Supabase gte-small) exists but nothing fills it. Generate embeddings on create/update in the Edge Function and add a semantic search path next to full-text search.

title: Measure review timing before designing a review gate
description: Owner decision (2026-11-06): design the review gate step by step from evidence, not up front. Step 1 (now): a read-only stats view over node_events: (a) share of splits whose children were claimed or worked before the first review, (b) work wasted on splits later rejected, (c) time from split to first review, (d) rejection share and reason type. Step 2 (with real traffic): show 'not yet reviewed' on splits in the web view and agent responses. Step 3 (only if (b) shows real waste, and after contributor sign-in): block claiming or closing until a split is accepted, with a review_state field. Context: documentation/jobs/temp_job_first-tests/RESULTS.md, section Open. Status (2026-11-06): step 1 is live: GET /api/stats/reviews and the MCP tool review_stats (point-at version 8). On the first-tests data: 5 splits, work started before review on 4, 2 of 3 reviewed splits rejected, 1 with work under it, about 3.5 minutes to first review. Next: watch these numbers once real contributors use the tree, then decide step 2. Status (2026-11-10): waiting for real contributors; nothing to build until then.

title: Design adversarial traversal
description: Open question in DOC_POINT_AT_RISKS.md: agents that continually challenge existing goals so nothing is locked in. Decide when they run, how a node is challenged and what closes or keeps it; then add it to the process doc and the MCP tools.

title: In-app feedback widget
description: A small signed-in feedback form that writes to app_feedback with the page and environment. Depends on: Signals backend task.

title: Admin signals view and switch the signal adapter on
description: An admin-only view (role claim) to triage error clusters and feedback, and turn on loop-backlog's signal adapter so open signals become ranked backlog tasks. Depends on: Signals backend, error capture and feedback widget tasks.

title: Add a db:push-staging script or fix the adapter reference
description: The signal adapter (.agents/skills/loop-backlog/references/signal-adapter.md) tells the agent to run `pnpm run db:push-staging`, which does not exist. Either add a script that applies supabase/migrations to the staging project with a pinned Supabase CLI (needs project linking, which the owner must set up), or change the adapter to say the connector or CLI applies migrations. Protected file edit: needs owner approval. Context: documentation/DOC_DECISION_LOG.md § signals-backend D8.
